name: Mantle of Vileness
body:
School evocation [evil]; Level antipaladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot-radius centered on you
Duration 1 round/level

You radiate an unholy power out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional power to combat the lackeys of good. While in the aura’s radius your allies deal 1d6 extra damage on melee or ranged attacks against good-aligned foes. If the target is a good outsider, the damage is increased to 1d8.
